name: Colonel Malone
role: Stock agent of the Chicago, Milwaukee & St. Paul railway
bio: Colonel Malone was the stock agent of the Chicago, Milwaukee & St. Paul railway. He passed through Medora in 1885 and 1886.

moments.label: Passed through en route to Chicago

mentions: Col. Malone, known everywhere on the line as stock agent of C. M. & St. P., was in Medora Saturday.
Colonel Malone, stock agent for the Milwaukee road, was on the train Sunday morning bound for Chicago. He says that the shipping of cattle on the N. P. is finished for this year…
Colonel Malone went through Medora yesterday morning on his way to St. Paul to meet his wife.
